intro: This urge will come and go. Let's stay with it together for a few minutes.

breath.title: Breathing
breath.desc: Quick calm: take two short breaths in and one long breath out. In studies, a few minutes of slow breathing had positive effects on reducing stress.

puzzle.title: Block Puzzle
puzzle.desc: Place the pieces on the board and full rows disappear. In studies, a visual puzzle that keeps your mind busy reduced the strength of cravings.
puzzle.srHint: This puzzle is played by looking at the screen. With a screen reader on, we suggest the breathing tool.

delay.title: Delay 10 minutes
delay.desc: Just put off the decision for 10 minutes. Cravings often peak within a few minutes and then fade.
ideas: Wash your hands and splash water on your face
Put on a song and sing along
delay.done: The 10 minutes are up. The decision is yours again; the craving has probably eased a little.

reasons.title: My reasons
reasons.desc: Remind yourself in your own words why you want to quit.
reasons.empty: You don't have any reasons saved yet.

alo: You're not alone. If you're in Türkiye, the counsellors at ALO 171 can talk to you right now.

end.question: How are you now?
end.resistedBody: Getting through an urge without smoking teaches your brain a new path. Every craving you get through makes the next one easier.
end.hardBody: Sometimes the urge lasts a little longer. Try another tool, or call ALO 171 and talk to someone.
end.smokedBody: One cigarette doesn't erase your effort. Your total smoke-free days are kept. Understanding what happened helps you be ready next time.
